terms.short: The mobile phone number of a subscriber (Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number).
terms.detail: A 10–15 digit number that uniquely identifies a mobile subscription on a public telephone network. In Indian CDRs this is usually a 10-digit number (optionally prefixed with 91).
terms.detail_hi: मोबाइल सब्सक्राइबर की अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पहचान संख्या — भारत में आमतौर पर 10 अंकों की होती है (91 कोड के साथ या बिना)।

terms.short: The number that initiated the call (A-party).
terms.detail: In a CDR, the calling_number is the originator of the call or SMS. Direction of the call is derived from comparing calling_number / called_number to the subscriber being analysed.
terms.detail_hi: CDR में calling_number वह नंबर है जिसने कॉल या SMS शुरू किया। दिशा (incoming/outgoing) इस नंबर और called_number की तुलना से तय होती है।

terms.short: The number that received the call (B-party).
terms.detail: The recipient of the call or SMS. For a given subscriber, calls where they are in calling_number are outgoing; calls where they are in called_number are incoming.

terms.short: Date and time when the call started.
terms.short_hi: कॉल शुरू होने की तिथि और समय।
terms.detail: Normally stored in local (IST) time. Useful for hourly/daily pattern analysis, night-call percentage, and geofencing against tower locations.

terms.short: Call duration in seconds.
terms.detail: Zero duration usually indicates a missed call or SMS; values under a few seconds can indicate burner-phone behaviour or network-drop.

terms.short: Whether the record is voice, SMS, data, or a special service.
terms.short_hi: रिकॉर्ड का प्रकार — voice / SMS / data आदि।
terms.detail: Common values: VoiceMO (outgoing voice), VoiceMT (incoming voice), SMSMO (outgoing SMS), SMSMT (incoming SMS), GPRS / LTE (data session).

terms.short: International Mobile Equipment Identity — the 15-digit device fingerprint.
terms.detail: A unique number assigned to the handset. Multiple SIMs on the same IMEI indicate the same physical phone; an IMEI change for the same number indicates a device swap. Tracked with TAC (Type Allocation Code) in the first 8 digits.

terms.short: International Mobile Subscriber Identity — the 14–15 digit SIM fingerprint.
terms.detail: Identifies the SIM itself, including operator (MCC+MNC prefix) and subscriber. A change of IMSI on the same IMEI indicates a SIM swap.

terms.short: Identifier of the cell tower/sector used during the call.
terms.short_hi: कॉल के समय उपयोग में आए सेल टावर की पहचान (CGI / Cell-ID).
terms.detail: Combined with LAC/TAC, gives the geographic cell. Used for tower-dump cross-matching, suspect-movement trails, and proximity/geofence analysis.

terms.short: Physical address or site name of the tower used during the event.
terms.short_hi: उस टावर का पता या साइट नाम जिसने कॉल हैंडल की।

terms.short: Latitude of the serving tower.
Longitude of the serving tower.
The telecom operator (Airtel, Jio, Vi, BSNL, ...).
Originating IP address of the data session.
terms.detail: In IPDR, typically the NAT'd private/public IP assigned to the subscriber by the carrier for the session.

terms.short: Destination IP the subscriber connected to.
terms.short_hi: जिस IP से कनेक्ट किया गया उसका पता।

terms.short: Originating port for the data session.
Destination port of the remote service (e.g. 443 for HTTPS).
Network protocol — TCP, UDP, ICMP.
Start time of the data session.
Total bytes transferred during the session.
terms.detail: Uplink + downlink bytes. Useful for spotting large uploads (possible evidence transfer) or sustained streaming.

terms.short: The subscriber phone number (SDR / Subscriber Detail Record).
Registered name of the subscriber as per KYC.
Registered address of the subscriber as per KYC.
Date the SIM/connection was activated.
Telecom circle (Maharashtra, Delhi, Gujarat, ...) — the licensed service area for this connection.
Type of identity proof submitted at KYC (Aadhaar, PAN, passport, ...).
Number of the identity proof submitted at KYC.
Timestamp of the tower-dump event (call/SMS/LU).

abbreviations.cgi: Cell Global Identity — MCC + MNC + LAC + Cell-ID
abbreviations.mnc: Mobile Network Code — operator identifier within a country
abbreviations.lac: Location Area Code — group of cells under one MSC
abbreviations.tac: Tracking Area Code (LTE) or Type Allocation Code (IMEI)
abbreviations.lu: Location Update — the phone registering with the network
abbreviations.bts: Base Transceiver Station — the physical radio at a tower
abbreviations.kyc: Know Your Customer — subscriber verification record
